datasets.title: FORCE 2020 Well well log and lithofacies dataset for machine learning competition
provenance_notes: The Zenodo description reports 118 Norwegian Sea wells.
The depositor states that the logs were slightly cleaned and partially despiked.
The depositor states that skilled geoscientists created the lithofacies and lithology interpretation.
The depositor states that the original well-log data came from the Norwegian government under a NOLD 2.0 license.
datasets.repository_license_exclusion: This dataset and all extracted or derived third-party content are excluded from the repository MIT license.
